name: cadence
tagline: Quality at agentic velocity. Research, Gates, Sweeps.
description: When agents produce code 10–50× faster than your CI absorbs it, quality stops being a single review moment and becomes a recurring practice. Cadence ships the practice as installable skills: a 5-standard PR review, three additional inline review lenses (silent failures, security semantics, test-coverage semantics) that catch what pattern-checks miss, a scope-change drill for receiving agent completion summaries, a research workflow grounded in diagram-as-thinking, and a sweep schedule that ratchets accumulated drift into stronger future gates.
